messages.subject: New shiny App: diveRsity-online
parts:
Hi All,

I have managed to put together this app, built entirely in RStudio using shiny. The app is intended (eventually) to be used for formal analyses of population genetics data. As it is, given the experimental nature of the 'fileInput' button, the app can only accept user-specific input when run locally.

Visit http://glimmer.rstudio.com/kkeenan/diveRsity-online/ to try it for yourself.

Source code can be found at https://github.com/kkeenan02/diveRsity-online.

As an aside, I consider myself a very amateur programmer (trial and error type). Given my very modest abilities in programming and the fact that even I can put together an app like diveRsity-online, I think is testament to the simplicity and usability of the shiny framework. Well done with the package and RStudio.

Cheers

Kevin
